score_note: A premium score is not claimable until the repaired bundle is deployed and browser-verified.

home.root_cause: Production shelf IDs carry long editorial slugs while the V4 layout resolver compared them with short CSS area keys, so the fallback emitted one full-width row per group.
home.hero_white_rectangle: Not a live DOM defect; it is the white/red annotation in the supplied screenshot. The live hero art loads without that rectangle.

library.cover_gap_behavior: The cards render a deterministic graphical fallback because the production API returns no canonical front-cover URL.
library.root_cause: This is not a failed HTTP image; it is missing canonical cover metadata. No committed safe front-cover asset was available to wire into production.
library.repair_policy: Keep release truth intact and improve the deterministic fallback motifs without inventing or claiming a canonical cover.

source_changes: Normalize long production shelf IDs and explicit layout_area values to compact CSS areas.
Pack only present shelves into occupied desktop/tablet/mobile grid cells.
Use deterministic content-bound vector motifs for Devdas and Pather Panchali fallback artwork.
Add focused layout and cover fallback tests.
